Yeap volatility of fees Of which miners are benefiting right now, cause of defi And which in fiat (like it or not miner's costs are in fiat) this volatility we talk about means price variations between cents of a dolar to a little more than a dolar, which is cheap > Yeap volatility of fees I don't know that I would classify the UX problem this generally, but volatility is part of the problem. Come on... Metamask does it for you 1559 makes it so users can all but ignore the gas price auction problem and just be presented with a price that they can either accept or decline. We pay for security with issuance, which is nice and clean. This means we need to overpay for security even more because we have to compensate miners for the volatility risk they are taking.
